summary: Resumed from handoffs/15 (Phase 21 PARTIAL -- accTargetsNeRoot top-loop pair landed, primary deliverable blocked on the missing FiveWorldInv step-preservation proof, the Hintikka wall). This dispatch built and landed the full four-step recipe the blocker's note recorded, with one necessary technical refinement discovered and documented as a deviation. Step 1: expandedRootTagsFive/FiveWorldInvE (FiveSimplification.lean) -- the e-aware refinement of FiveWorldInv actually needed for a step-local induction proof (a careful per-step trace showed the recipe's literal e-independent S5wTagInv-and-FiveWorldInv shape is not step-preservable: a root-triggered mint consumes a root tag that was already counted the moment its trigger appeared on the branch, chronologically before the mint fires, so a bare presence-based counter cannot show the required per-step growth at that step; the fix counts a root tag only once its trigger has been dequeued into e, restoring the lockstep-growth argument). Step 2: modalApplyOneFive_worldGrowth (mirrors modalApplyOneS5w_step, doubled for root/non-root) + modalStepBranchFive_preserves_worldInv (mirrors modalStepBranchS5w_preserves_worldInv, three-way case split) -- FiveSimplification.lean. Step 3: ModalLoopAuxFive + _bounds + _stepPreserved + modalLoopInvHintikkaFive_initial -- FrameCompleteness.lean. Step 4 (the payoff): modalTableauFive_complete + fiveValid_decides + instDecidableFiveValid, assembled exactly as modalTableauS5_complete/instDecidableS5Valid do -- FrameCompleteness.lean. All landed sorry-free, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only (confirmed via lake env lean + #print axioms on every new public declaration). Full CI green: lake build (3240/3240), checkInitImports exit 0, lake lint (only the pre-existing PrimeExclusion.lean baseline remains, after adding @[nolint unusedArguments] to ModalLoopAuxFive caught during this dispatch's own lint run), lake exe lint-style exit 0, lake shake (no import changes suggested for either touched file), lake test green (9230/9231, pre-existing Intuitionistic/Minimal sorry warnings unrelated). Live regression probe (the plan's own Verification requirement) confirms decide (fiveValid (box p -> p)) = false while decide (s5Valid (box p -> p)) = true, confirming the route is genuinely at fiveFC and not silently at s5FC. Plan file's Phase 21 marked [COMPLETED], checklist fully checked off with deviation notes, BLOCKER note replaced with a RESOLVED note (staged via git hash-object/update-index against HEAD's blob to precisely exclude stray, pre-existing, uncommitted Phase 22/23 [IN PROGRESS] markers from a concurrent session, which remain untouched in the working tree). Task 504's re-scoped deliverable's first half (fiveValid decidability) is now fully shipped. Phases 22-23 (KB5) NOT started this dispatch, per the hard constraint.
